Fire in Maharashtra high-rise kills two women, injures six

A fire broke out in the 14-storey Imperial Heights building in Nalasopara, Palghar, Maharashtra, resulting in the deaths of two women. Six individuals were hospitalized, and approximately 25 people were rescued from the blaze. The cause of the fire was not immediately specified in the coverage.
